claims.statement: Pytest is configured for tests/ with 90 percent app coverage fail-under, omitting app/static.
Architecture tests forbid application imports of FastAPI, LiteLLM, Mem0, Presidio, and Redis, and require a single Router owner in infrastructure/router.py.
Route-surface tests require native chat, OpenAI chat and embeddings, health, ready, metrics, config, memory, and admin keys in OpenAPI.
The Next.js console is verified with vitest run, not by starting uvicorn from web tests.
